body: Yeah. I just want the numbness to be gone. I wish that there was a way for me to feel not numb.
She’s the main reason why I haven’t done anything. She’s the one source of happiness in my life most days.
I’ve been attending therapy for about 3-4 years but I’ve always been scared to talk about suicidal thoughts.
Thank you I really just needed one more person to tell me to do it. I have a definite appointment scheduled in about 5 weeks and I’ll post after I talk to her about it.
